newsitem.title: USA: Progenics cuts IPO pricing range to $7-$9.
newsitem.headline: Progenics cuts IPO pricing range to $7-$9.

text.p: Progenics Pharmaceuticals Inc has cut the estimated pricing range for its upcoming initial public offering to $7 to $9 a share, according to a regulatory filing.

The company previously estimated shares would price between $11 to $13. The two million share offering is due later this week, according to lead underwriter Oppenheimer & Co. The shares are due to trade on the Nasdaq under the symbol "PRGN".
The biopharmaceutical company develops products to treat and prevent cancer and viral diseases.
